title.narrative: Maroc - Assistance Technique : Dialogue national sur les nouveaux rôles constitutionnels de la Société Civile
Morocco - Technical Assistance: National Dialogue on New Constitutional Roles for Civil Society

description.narrative: Les principaux bénéficiaires du projet sont: le Gouvernement et la Société Civile Marocaine.
The main beneficiaries of the project are: the Government and the Moroccan Civil Society.
L’objectif recherché à travers cet appui est la consultation de l’ensemble des acteurs de la société civile afin d’élaborer une politique de consultation publique.
The objective sought through this support is the consultation of all the actors of the civil society in order to develop a public consultation policy.

The present project concerns the technical assistance for the national dialogue on the new constitutional roles of civil society. Indeed, on ministerial decision, and according to the provisions of the new constitution within the framework of the activation of the participative democracy, a national dialogue is started. This project has the support of the African Development Bank through a donation from the funds of countries in transition of 335,200 euros. This support should help put in place legislation that regulates the involvement of civil society in the public sphere, in order to devote participatory democracy.

title.narrative: Regional consultations and consultation forums organised

actual.value: Several legal platforms have emerged from the national dialogue, the legal decrees relating to motions and petitions, those relating to associative life, public consultation and the national charter constitute the foundations and bases of the national consultation policy

title.narrative: At least 2 consultations per year are organised before the parliamentary sessions (autumn and spring)

actual.value: Since 2014, associations have been invited by parliamentary committees to debate draft laws being adopted by parliament, in addition to their presence in the various constitutional dialogue and consultation bodies

target.value: Elaboration of the national charter for participatory democracy

actual.value: The national conference led to the drafting of the national charter for participatory democracy, which includes a moral and political commitment in accordance with the constitution and duly recognised international values in this area

target.value: The institutional framework for Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) consultation is defined

actual.value: The national dialogue has enabled the institutionalisation of CSO consultation. The entire legal arsenal has been developed and implemented

title.narrative: Moroccan civil society organisations have the right to make motions and petitions

actual.value: The organic law n°44-14 on petitions, and the law 64-14 on motions are voted as well as the application decrees and were promulgated in the Official Bulletin 6492, published on 18 August 2016
